# Zutok Softwares

> Zutok Softwares makes Zutok CRM, an all-in-one CRM built for Indian businesses and priced in rupees. Three products plug into it: ZChat, a WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram inbox with an AI sales agent; ZShop, which sends WhatsApp order updates, COD confirmations and abandoned-cart reminders for Shopify, WooCommerce and in-house stores; and Zloya, which runs loyalty points, VIP tiers, memberships and retention journeys for restaurants, cafés, salons and stores. Plans start at ₹799/month (billed monthly, excluding 18% GST), and the Complete Suite of all four starts at ₹2,299/month.

- Website: https://www.zutok.in/
- Company: Zutok Softwares, also called Zutok. Its products are always named with the brand: Zutok CRM, Zutok ZChat, Zutok ZShop, Zutok Zloya.
- Market: businesses in India that sell on WhatsApp, Instagram and at the counter.
- Prices: in Indian Rupees (INR), excluding 18% GST. Billed monthly, or yearly at 10 months for 12. No setup fee.
- WhatsApp: ZChat connects to the official WhatsApp Business Platform. Meta's per-message charges for WhatsApp template messages are billed separately at Meta's published rates.
- Contact: admin@zutok.in. Book a demo at https://www.zutok.in/#demo. Customers log in at https://crm.zutok.in/.

## Products

- [Zutok CRM](https://www.zutok.in/products/crm/): CRM software for small businesses. CRM software for small businesses in India: leads, customers, proposals, GST invoices, projects, HRM, payroll and inventory in one CRM. Chats from ZChat, orders from ZShop and guests from Zloya land in the same place. Plans from ₹799/month billed monthly, excl. 18% GST.
- [Zutok ZChat](https://www.zutok.in/products/zchat/): Omnichannel inbox + AI agent. WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram land in one shared inbox. An AI agent answers in seconds, your team takes over when it matters, and every chat becomes a lead in your CRM. Plans from ₹799/month billed monthly, excl. 18% GST.
- [Zutok ZShop](https://www.zutok.in/products/zshop/): Shopify & WooCommerce WhatsApp integration. Connect Shopify, WooCommerce or your in-house counter. ZShop brings every order into the CRM, confirms cash-on-delivery on WhatsApp, recovers abandoned carts and keeps buyers updated until the parcel arrives. Plans from ₹1,299/month billed monthly, excl. 18% GST.
- [Zutok Zloya](https://www.zutok.in/products/zloya/): Loyalty program software. Loyalty program software for restaurants, cafés, salons and stores. Award points at the counter, sell memberships, run automated win-back journeys and collect guest feedback and Google reviews. Plans from ₹999/month billed monthly, excl. 18% GST.

## Solutions

- [All Zutok solutions](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/): How Zutok handles WhatsApp CRM, AI sales, broadcasts, templates, team inbox, comment-to-DM, COD, cart recovery, order tracking, loyalty, GST and HRM.
- [WhatsApp automation](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/whatsapp-automation/): Everything Zutok automates on WhatsApp: AI replies from your catalogue, broadcasts, COD confirmation, order updates, cart reminders and handoff to your team.
- [WhatsApp Business API](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/whatsapp-business-api/): Getting the WhatsApp Business API with Zutok ZChat: help setting up and verifying your number, what runs on it, and the two costs, your ZChat plan and Meta's charges at cost.
- [WhatsApp AI sales agent](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/whatsapp-ai-sales-agent/): How Zutok ZChat's AI agent asks each choice on WhatsApp and quotes the price, order link and files from your own catalogue rows, with human handoff.
- [WhatsApp broadcasting](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/whatsapp-broadcast-campaigns/): How Zutok ZChat sends bulk WhatsApp campaigns with Meta-approved templates and shows sent, delivered and read numbers as they come in.
- [WhatsApp message templates](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/whatsapp-message-templates/): What a WhatsApp template message is, when the 24-hour rule means you need one, and how to create, categorise and get templates approved in Zutok ZChat.
- [Omnichannel team inbox](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/omnichannel-team-inbox/): How a team of 2, 5 or 15 answers WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram from one Zutok ZChat inbox, with views, statuses, labels, auto-assign and team reports.
- [WhatsApp CRM](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/whatsapp-crm/): How Zutok turns every WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram chat into a CRM lead with its source, then follows it from Enquiry to Customer and invoice.
- [Instagram automation](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/instagram-comment-to-dm/): How Zutok ZChat automates Instagram: a public reply and a private DM for every comment on posts and reels, and an AI agent that answers DMs from your catalogue.
- [Facebook Messenger automation](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/facebook-messenger-automation/): How Zutok ZChat automates a Facebook Page: AI answers in Messenger, a public reply and private DM for post and reel comments, and every chat saved as a CRM lead.
- [WhatsApp COD confirmation](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/whatsapp-cod-confirmation/): How Zutok ZShop asks COD buyers to confirm on WhatsApp before dispatch, reminds them and tags the order, with auto-cancel off by default.
- [Abandoned cart recovery on WhatsApp](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/abandoned-cart-recovery-whatsapp/): How Zutok ZShop sends three WhatsApp cart reminders (after 1 hour, 1 day and 3 days) with discounts on the later two, quiet hours and one do-not-contact list.
- [WhatsApp order updates & courier tracking](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/whatsapp-order-updates-courier-tracking/): How Zutok ZShop sends placed, packed, shipped and delivered updates on WhatsApp, checks courier status and learns your real delivery times.
- [Memberships & prepaid wallets](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/restaurant-membership-prepaid-wallet/): How Zutok Zloya sells yearly perk memberships and prepaid wallets at the counter, with OTP-protected redemptions and a staff sales leaderboard.
- [Smart QR codes for guest data](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/restaurant-qr-code-customer-data/): How Zutok Zloya smart QR codes on tables, Swiggy and Zomato boxes and partner stores collect guest numbers, with scans and opt-ins tracked per code.
- [Birthday, win-back & expiry journeys](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/automated-winback-birthday-campaigns/): How Zutok Zloya's five automated journeys (welcome, birthday, 30-day win-back, points expiry and feedback) bring guests back with phone-locked coupons.
- [CRM with GST invoicing](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/gst-invoicing-crm/): How Zutok CRM turns accepted proposals and estimates into GST invoices with CGST and SGST lines, payments, credit notes and bulk PDF export.
- [Lead management: IndiaMART & Meta Lead Ads](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/indiamart-meta-lead-ads-crm/): How Zutok CRM syncs IndiaMART and Meta Lead Ads leads into one pipeline with chat and website leads, from Enquiry to Customer.
- [CRM with HRM](https://www.zutok.in/solutions/crm-with-hrm-payroll/): How Zutok CRM Growth keeps staff records, contracts, salary, shifts, attendance and leave in the same system as your sales.

## Industries

- [All industry guides](https://www.zutok.in/industries/): How restaurants, D2C brands, real estate firms, agencies, clinics, salons and retail chains in India use Zutok CRM, ZChat, ZShop and Zloya, with prices in ₹.
- [Restaurants & cafés](https://www.zutok.in/industries/restaurants-cafes/): A CRM for Indian restaurants and cafés. Points at the counter, QR on every table and delivery box, birthday journeys and guest feedback.
- [D2C & fashion brands](https://www.zutok.in/industries/d2c-fashion-brands/): WhatsApp automation for D2C and fashion brands. WhatsApp order updates, COD confirmation, cart recovery and an AI that answers “is it in stock?”
- [Real estate](https://www.zutok.in/industries/real-estate/): Real estate CRM for Indian brokers and property managers. Properties, owners, brokers, buy and rent requests, and site-visit leads from Meta ads.
- [Agencies & services](https://www.zutok.in/industries/agencies-services/): CRM for agencies and service businesses in India. Proposals, GST invoices, projects, timesheets and a shared inbox for every client.
- [Clinics, labs & salons](https://www.zutok.in/industries/clinics-labs-salons/): WhatsApp automation for clinics, labs and salons. Appointment chats, test price lists the AI can quote, memberships and repeat-visit reminders.
- [Retail & franchises](https://www.zutok.in/industries/retail-franchises/): CRM for retail stores, chains and franchises. Inventory, staff attendance, loyalty across outlets, and one view of every customer.

## Pricing

- [Zutok plans and prices](https://www.zutok.in/pricing/): Zutok CRM from ₹799/month, ZChat from ₹799, Zloya from ₹999, ZShop from ₹1,299, Complete Suite from ₹2,299. Excl. GST; yearly plans give 2 months free.
- [Zutok Complete Suite](https://www.zutok.in/pricing/#all-plans): from ₹2,299/month billed monthly, excl. 18% GST. Zutok CRM + ZChat + ZShop + Zloya together, about 40% less than buying them separately.
- [Zutok CRM](https://www.zutok.in/products/crm/#pricing): from ₹799/month billed monthly, excl. 18% GST.
- [Zutok ZChat](https://www.zutok.in/products/zchat/#pricing): from ₹799/month billed monthly, excl. 18% GST. Meta's per-message charges for WhatsApp template messages are billed separately at Meta's published rates.
- [Zutok ZShop](https://www.zutok.in/products/zshop/#pricing): from ₹1,299/month billed monthly, excl. 18% GST. Needs ZChat for WhatsApp delivery. Meta's per-message charges for template messages are billed separately.
- [Zutok Zloya](https://www.zutok.in/products/zloya/#pricing): from ₹999/month billed monthly, excl. 18% GST.
